# Practical AI use {#sec-practical-ai-use}

*A short, tool-light guide to using the assistant in the browser for this course. Shared by weeks four and five.*

::: {.callout-note}
## Draft stub — planned contents
How to ask for something clearly, how to give the assistant the context it needs, how to read a reply critically, and how to tell a helpful answer from a confident-sounding but unchecked one. Kept deliberately light and tool-agnostic because the interface changes from term to term. The point is habits, not clicks.
:::
